mechanism: row-to-core balance / low-precision wide-row block-index ownership mapping
hypothesis: A half-grid cyclic logical-block rotation may reduce the distant row-band jumps created by center-out block mapping, without changing row ownership counts or work per block. Rows fewer than available cores remain inherently underutilized because each block must own a complete normalization row.
change: In ProcessWideLowPrecision, map physical block b to logical block (b + floor(blockCount / 2)) % blockCount instead of the center-out order. Block count, row ownership set, per-block row count, arithmetic, UB buffers, tile sizes, and reduction topology are unchanged.

scope_check.details: Only the physical-block to logical-block ownership mapping changed. Per-row GM address generation, rowOffset/column stride formulas, and Scalar address-generation code remain untouched; no N05 mechanism is included.

scheduler_validation.command: python3 -c 'for blocks in range(1,4097): mapping=[(idx+blocks//2)%blocks for idx in range(blocks)]; assert len(set(mapping))==blocks and min(mapping)==0 and max(mapping)==blocks-1; print("half-grid rotation bijection passed for blockCount=1..4096")'
scheduler_validation.output: half-grid rotation bijection passed for blockCount=1..4096
scheduler_validation.scope_note: Static permutation coverage only; not runtime correctness or performance validation.
